meta.title: feat: replace VList with ag-grid for better mail list performance
meta.body_summary: Replace VList virtualization with ag-grid in mail-list.tsx for better mail list scrolling performance, adding ag-grid dependencies, custom CSS, and infinite row model.

perf_labels.notes: Devin replaced VList with ag-grid but introduced bugs (infinite scroll disabled, filtering broken); no human review, auto-closed after inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 417 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small-to-medium frontend refactor by absolute volume. As a UI virtualization swap, it was closed without merge due to functional bugs and lack of human review.

review_details.concern_detail: cursor[bot] identified that loadMore() is commented out in ag-grid datasource, breaking infinite scrolling, and a useEffect for category filtering is commented out, breaking category navigation. greptile and graphite noted style issues (any types, !important).
review_details.performance_claim: Replace VList with ag-grid for better performance on large mail lists.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by Devin bot due to 7+ days inactivity; cursor[bot] reported critical bugs that were never fixed.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Complex frontend virtualization swap using ag-grid; agent introduced critical bugs and was unable to resolve them despite follow-up commits; automatic closure after inactivity.

detection_detail.code_reading: Automated bot review detected broken infinite scrolling and category filtering, as well as style issues.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiler data; performance claim is narrative. The implementation itself was non-functional, preventing any perf testing.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No human intervention; Devin bot auto-closed after 7 days without addressing bot-identified bugs.

core_change_summary.description: In mail-list.tsx, replaced VList virtualization with AgGridReact infinite row model and added custom ag-grid-mail.css to strip grid chrome; added ag-grid dependencies to package.json and vite config, updated lockfiles.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most churn is in mail-list.tsx (323 lines) and new CSS (28 lines); other files are configuration and lockfile updates.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: replace VList with ag-grid implementation and add CSS.
Human maintainer (MrgSub) adjusted imports, removed unused code, and patched novel dependency.
Final commit by Devin: attempted to fix infinite scrolling by adding useRef loading state tracking, but did not uncomment loadMore call.

review_signals.summary: Identified that loadMore() is commented out (breaking infinite scrolling) and a useEffect for category filtering is commented out (breaking category navigation).
review_signals.action_taken: No follow-up fix; PR eventually closed.

review_signals.summary: Suggested replacing any with a proper TypeScript interface for ThreadCellRenderer props.
Advised against !important for overflow and suggested AG Grid API configuration.
Recommended defining an interface for ThreadCellRenderer props instead of using any.
Suggested using IGetRowsParams instead of any for getRows parameter.

Greptile bot reviewed within seconds, noted style issues.
Cursor bot reviewed ~1 hour later, flagged two critical functional bugs.
Graphite bot reviewed ~2 hours later, echoed style suggestions.
Devin attempted one fix commit but did not address the bugs.
No human interaction over 8 days; Devin auto-closed for inactivity.
